site: Unnamed Seamount 03 - Northwest of Holanikū (Kure Atoll)
expedition: Beyond the Blue: Papahanaumokuakea ROV and Mapping
purpose: The goal of EX2503 Dive 10 was to explore the southern ridge arm of this unnamed seamount, northwest of Holanikū (Kure Atoll), and to investigate geological features that could provide clues to the age and provenance of seamounts in this region. Another key goal was to characterize the ecosystem of this seamount ridge arm, including key faunal components and organismal interactions.
